description: This file provides a class-based implementation for managing the conversation context with OpenAI's language models within the Pipecat project. It includes handling messages, tools, multimedia content, and logging support, along with deprecated classes for backward compatibility.

classes.name: CustomEncoder
classes.description: Custom JSON encoder for handling special data types in logging, particularly io.BytesIO objects, converting binary data to a hex string for easier logging.

classes.name: OpenAILLMContext
classes.description: Manages conversation context for OpenAI LLM interactions within Pipecat, including message history, tools, multimedia content, and logging support. It provides methods to manipulate messages, convert formats, and handle multimedia frames. It is deprecated in favor of a more universal LLMContext.

classes.name: OpenAILLMContextFrame
classes.description: A frame containing OpenAI-specific LLM context data, including messages and configurations, intended for integration within Pipecat's frame processing system. This class is deprecated.

methods.description: Sets the LLM adapter to customize tool and message processing.

methods.description: Creates an OpenAILLMContext instance initialized with a list of message dictionaries.

methods.description: Passthrough function for converting a message from OpenAI message format to the standard format (no change).

methods.name: get_messages_for_initializing_history(self)

methods.name: get_messages_for_persistent_storage(self)

methods.description: Sets the tool selection mechanism for the context.

methods.description: Sets the tools available for the LLM; disables tools if an empty list provided.
